basic_details.job_title: CSKHPKV Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agronomy, College of Agriculture, C.S.K. Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV), Palampur, is offering one Young Professional-I fellowship under the Adhoc project "Pilot project for crop diversification", with Kullu as the operational area. The fellowship pays Rs. 30000/- per month (fixed) and is co-terminus with the project. Candidates need a B.Sc. in Agriculture or a Diploma in relevant Agricultural Sciences/Engineering/Technology. Applications go offline on the prescribed proforma with a bank draft and must reach the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, C

how_to_apply: Applications are made offline on the prescribed proforma. The notice says the proforma is "given overleaf", but the PDF provided has only one page. The application, complete in all respects, must reach the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10 November 2026 at 05:00 PM.
Fill in the application on the prescribed proforma, complete in all respects.
Get a Bank Draft for the application processing fee (Rs. 450/- for General, Rs. 110/- for reserved categories) in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.
Attach the Bank Draft and self-attested copies of your educational certificates to the application.
Send or deliver the application so that it reaches the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10.11.2026, 05:00 PM.

The application form fee and the other related terms and conditions are set out in Registrar's CSKHPKV, Palampur notification No. QSD.6-54./CSKHPKV/Rectt/2015/- 4650-4749 and even file No. 4750-4849 dated 30.01.2016. The notice says this can be downloaded from the University website, https://hillagric.ac.in.
Bank Draft for the application processing fee, in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur
Self-attested copies of educational certificates (sent with the application)
Original certificates and other testimonials (brought to the work specific interaction)
important_instructions: No separate letter will be sent to candidates about the work specific interaction. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the work specific interaction. Applications must be complete in all respects and must come with the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About CSKHPKV
content_sections.text: C.S.K. Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV) is an agricultural university in Palampur, Himachal Pradesh (PIN 176062). This fellowship notice comes from the Department of Agronomy of its College of Agriculture. The fellowship is offered under the department's Adhoc project "Pilot project for crop diversification", whose operational area is Kullu.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention an age limit or a work experience requirement for this fellowship. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Young Professional-I gets a monthly remuneration of Rs. 30000/- per month (fixed). The fellowship is purely temporary. It is co-terminus with the expiry of the project "Pilot project for crop diversification" and depends on the availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSKHPKV Young Professional-I (One)
content_sections.text: Applications are made offline on the prescribed proforma. The notice says the proforma is "given overleaf", but the PDF provided has only one page. The application, complete in all respects, must reach the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10 November 2026 at 05:00 PM. Fill in the application on the prescribed proforma, complete in all respects. Get a Bank Draft for the application processing fee (Rs. 450/- for General, Rs. 110/- for reserved categories) in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur. Attach the Bank Draft and self-attested copies of your educational certificates to the application. Send or deliver the application so that it reaches the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10.11.2026, 05:00 PM. The application form fee and the other related terms and conditions are set out in Registrar's CSKHPKV, Palampur notification No. QSD.6-54./CSKHPKV/Rectt/2015/- 4650-4749 and even file No. 4750-4849 dated 30.01.2016. The notice says this can be downloaded from the University website, https://hillagric.ac.in. Application on the prescribed proforma Bank Draft for the application processing fee, in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur Self-attested copies of educational certificates (sent with the application) Original certificates and other testimonials (brought to the work specific interaction)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I fellowship is through a work specific interaction. It will be held in the office of the undersigned (the Head, Department of Agronomy) on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. If that day turns out to be a holiday, the interaction will be held on the next working day at the same time. Candidates should bring their original certificates and other testimonials to the interaction.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No separate letter will be sent to candidates about the work specific interaction. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the work specific interaction. Applications must be complete in all respects and must come with the application fee.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSKHPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) Young Professional-I fellowship in the Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I fellowship?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10 November 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CSKHPKV Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: You need a B.Sc. in Agriculture, or a Diploma in relevant Agricultural Sciences/Engineering/Technology. A Post Graduate degree in Agriculture and working knowledge of computers are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of CSKHPKV Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 30000/- per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I fellowship?
faq.answer: The application processing fee is Rs. 450/- for General candidates and Rs. 110/- for reserved categories. It is paid by Bank Draft in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I fellowship?
faq.answer: Apply offline on the prescribed proforma. Attach the fee Bank Draft and self-attested copies of your educational certificates, and make sure the application reaches the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy, CSKHPKV, Palampur, by 10 November 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSKHPKV Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Selection is through a work specific interaction on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 AM in the office of the Head, Department of Agronomy. If that day is a holiday, it moves to the next working day at the same time.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I fellowship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The fellowship is purely temporary and is co-terminus with the expiry of the "Pilot project for crop diversification", subject to the availability of funds.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the CSKHPKV work specific interaction?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for the work specific interaction, and no separate letter will be sent to candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the CSKHPKV Young Professional-I posted?
faq.answer: The operational area of the "Pilot project for crop diversification" is Kullu.
